title: Story premise EDU079: The Shopping Bag’s Hidden Timeline
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (environment/ecology). Hook: Which parts of this bag’s life did the comparison leave out? Takeaway/theme: Environmental comparisons depend on boundaries, assumptions, use, and local end-of-life conditions.
description: A shopper wants to compare two bags, but the picture at checkout hides production, repeated use, and disposal. A boundary slider exposes which lifecycle stages are included before any environmental comparison is made.
